offline.banner: You're offline — showing information saved on {when}.

install.title: Add Mandhira to your home screen
install.body: It opens like an app and your journey stays readable without a signal.

home.title: Plan around what matters.
home.intro: Tell Mandhira what your journey has to include, and it works out whether the days hold together.

state.tight: Tight — workable, but delays will have an effect.
state.at_risk: At risk — something may not fit. Let's look at options.
state.broken: This can't work as planned. Here's what would need to change.

cause.day_overruns: This day runs about {minutes} minutes past its end.
cause.fixed_unreachable: Everything before one of your fixed times needs about {minutes} minutes more than there is.
cause.outside_availability: Something is planned for {at}, when it isn't running.
cause.runs_past_availability: Something starting at {at} runs past {closes}, when it stops.
cause.dependency_broken: Something is planned before the thing it depends on.
cause.walking_over_limit: Walking is about {metres} m — above the {limitMetres} m that's comfortable for your group.
cause.not_step_free: One of these places isn't step-free.
cause.partly_step_free: One of these places is only partly step-free.
cause.step_free_unknown: We don't know whether one of these places is step-free.
cause.no_rest_in_stretch: There's about {minutes} minutes here without a proper break.
cause.return_guard_breached: You'd reach your return about {minutes} minutes late.

trust.unverified: {count, plural, one {# detail here hasn't been verified recently.} other {# details here haven't been verified recently.}}
trust.conflicting: {count, plural, one {# detail here has sources that disagree.} other {# details here have sources that disagree.}}

card.title: Something changed
card.why_fallback: This affects how the rest of the day fits together.

what.user_done_delta: That finished about {minutes} minutes off the plan.
what.knowledge_update: Something we know about your day has changed.
what.live_weather: The weather for your day has changed.
what.item_added: You added something to the day.
what.item_removed: You took something out of the day.
what.availability_changed: Opening times for one of these have changed.
what.preferences_changed: What matters to you has changed.

option.absorb_buffers: {minutes, plural, =0 {Use the free time you'd left} other {Use the spare time you'd left — about # minutes}}
option.shorten_item: Spend less time at {item} — about {toMinutes} minutes instead of {fromMinutes}
option.remove_important: Leave out {item}, even though you marked it important

because.nothing_moves: because the buffers were there for exactly this, and nothing you planned has to change.
because.keeps_everything: because everything stays in the day, just a little shorter.
because.nothing_removed: because nothing is taken out — it moves to a day where it fits.
because.keeps_protected: because it keeps what you said must happen, at a time it's still open.
because.protects_the_rest: because you marked it optional, and leaving it out keeps the rest of the day within reach.
because.last_resort: because nothing gentler brings the day back within reach, so it's your call.

keep.tight: It still works, with less room if anything slips.
keep.at_risk: It may still work, but there's no room left if anything slips.
keep.broken: The day won't work as planned, and something will be missed.

trust.unverified: This is based on information we're not fully sure of — worth checking locally.
trust.conflicting: Sources disagree about something this depends on — worth checking locally.
trust.changed: This is based on information that changed.

change.offline_note: Worked out from what's saved on this device. Your choice is kept and sent when there's a signal, and we'll check it again then.

rule.fixed_cannot_move: A fixed time can't be moved — it's what the rest of the day works around.
rule.fixed_cannot_remove: A fixed commitment can't be taken out from here.
rule.protected_cannot_remove: You marked this as something that must happen, so it stays. Change what matters first if your plans have changed.
rule.item_not_found: That part of the plan isn't there any more.

intent.entry_link: Or describe it in your own words
intent.title: Describe your journey
intent.lede: Say it the way you would to a friend — where, when, who is coming, and what has to happen. Mandhira turns it into a plan you check before anything is built.
intent.input_label: Your journey, in your own words
intent.input_hint: For example: three days in Tirumala from 14 October with my mother, who can't walk far. We must do the Suprabhatam seva. Our train home leaves at 6 pm on the 16th.
intent.too_short: Write a little more — a place and a few days is enough to start.
intent.problem: That didn't go through. Please try again.
intent.or_form: Prefer to answer a few questions?
intent.unavailable_title: Let's do it with a few questions instead
intent.unavailable_body: Mandhira can't read descriptions right now. The questions get you to the same plan.
intent.review_lede: This is what Mandhira understood. Anything marked Suggested is a guess — keep it or take it out before the plan is built.
intent.pace_full: Full — fit in as much as the day allows
intent.mobility_hint: Mandhira plans every day around the most limited need.
intent.like: What you would like to do
intent.none_named: Nothing named here. You can add things on the questions screen.
intent.return_hint: Mandhira works backwards from it. Choose the one that is your journey home, if any.
intent.unmatched_title: Not something Mandhira knows about yet
intent.unmatched_body: These aren't published yet, so they are not in the plan.
intent.unclear_body: Mandhira wasn't sure about these. Change anything above that isn't right.
intent.pending: {count, plural, one {One suggestion still needs Keep or Take out.} other {# suggestions still need Keep or Take out.}}
